business_summary: Hubei W-olf Photoelectric Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of precision optical components in China and internationally. It offers infrared cut-off filters, biometric filters, and microprisms to be used in camera optical imaging and sensing systems. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Jingzhou, China.
